value.name: man softens his bargaining language
value.description: Asha notices that the man no longer uses the aggressive phrases he had relied on earlier in the negotiations.
evidence: Asha noticed, use any of the phrases he had used in the first week: not "what I am owed," not "by right," not "before anyone else gets clever."

value.name: man revises loan terms
value.description: He says he has thought it over and is willing to accept a longer amortization if the interest rate is indexed as he specifies.
evidence: He said he had thought about it over the weekend, and that he understood Lucia could not refinance immediately, and that he was willing to accept a longer amortization than he had originally asked for if the interest rate was indexed in a way he described in some detail

value.name: Asha lets him explain terms
value.description: Asha allows him to continue explaining the indexing details, recognizing that the explanation restores some of his sense of competence.
evidence: Asha let him describe it, because describing it was a way of giving him back a piece of the competence he had spent the last two weeks misusing.

value.name: man addresses Lucia
value.description: When he finishes speaking, he turns to his sister and says her name.
evidence: When he finished, he looked at his sister.

value.name: Lucia proposes counteroffer
value.description: Lucia offers to accept the higher rate if he will accept a longer term.
evidence: She said that she was willing to accept the higher of the two rates Daniel had proposed if he was willing to accept a longer term.

value.name: Lucia reveals apartment sale
value.description: Lucia says she has spoken with her bank and can increase her closing payment because she has decided to sell her New York apartment.
evidence: She said she had spoken with her bank in New York and that she could put down a sum at closing larger than the one she had originally offered, because she had decided to sell her apartment, which was a thing she had not told anyone in the room, including Asha, before this moment.

value.name: Asha conceals reaction
value.description: Asha keeps her expression unchanged while Daniel visibly reacts to Lucia's revelation.
evidence: Asha did not let her face change. Daniel's face changed.

value.name: Lucia explains leaving New York
value.description: Lucia explains that she no longer needs two homes and has effectively been living elsewhere for years, making it possible to work from here instead.
evidence: "I have thought about it," she said. "I do not need two homes. I have not, really, lived in New York for some time. I have been editing from hotels and other people's spare rooms for three years. I can edit from here. I would like to edit from here."

value.name: Lucia reassesses apartment value
